summary: Solowin Holdings, a Cayman-incorporated Hong Kong-based broker-dealer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing a registered direct offering under its existing Form F-3 shelf. On November 5, 2026 it signed a securities purchase agreement with certain individual investors to sell 10,300,000 Class A ordinary shares at $1.20 per share, for gross proceeds of roughly $12.36 million before expenses. No placement agent, underwriter or broker-dealer was engaged and no fees are payable. Closing is expected on or about November 20, 2026, subject to customary conditions; proceeds fund repayment of September 10, 2026 promissory notes plus working capital. This is an ordinary shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch dilution and note-repayment execution.
